title: How does artificial intelligence create competitive advantages for enterprises? -- Discussion based on situated artificial intelligence theory
affiliations: Harbin University of Science and Technology, Harbin University of Science and Technology, Harbin Engineering University, Harbin University of Science and Technology and Harbin Engineering University

detail.title: How does artificial intelligence create competitive advantages for enterprises? -- Discussion based on situated artificial intelligence theory
detail.abstract: As an “accelerator” of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, artificial intelligence(AI) has become a critical driver of enterprise transformation. However, the mechanisms through which AI empowers competitive advantages remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on the theoretical perspective of situated AI, this study utilizes panel data from listed manufacturing companies in China between 2015 and 2023 to empirically examine the impact of situated AI on firms’ competitive advantage and explores the mediating role of the human–data interaction level. The main findings are as follows: (1) Situated AI—emerging from the integration of AI and firms' dynamic capabilities—can significantly enhance competitive advantage by increasing the specificity of AI technologies, internalizing explicit knowledge, and mitigating short-sightedness; (2) Innovation capability, absorptive capability, and adaptive capability positively moderate the relationship between AI and competitive advantage; (3) The human–data interaction level plays a mediating role between situated AI and competitive advantage; (4) Compared with non-state-owned enterprises and those located in western regions, state-owned enterprises and firms in the eastern and central regions benefit more from situated AI in enhancing competitive advantage. These findings provide a theoretical foundation for enterprises to build situated AI systems integrated with dynamic capabilities and offer actionable insights for managerial practice.

title: Jostling for Space: Mortality Salience and Human Agency in times of crisis
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Raipur, Indian Institute of Management Ranchi and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Jostling for Space: Mortality Salience and Human Agency in times of crisis
detail.abstract: Human beings are agentic creatures who also experience mortality salience. This paper examines how people regain agency when mortality salience is consciously experienced collectively. A study was conducted during the pandemic, when collective mortality salience resulted in death anxiety and a sense of lost control over one's life. The study revealed that people employ pathways of self-preservation and self-expansion to combat mortality salience. The findings indicated a gestalt switch from work to family and agency maintenance attempts in the face of death anxiety. The study showed how self-preservation and self-expansion relate to the intentionality, self-reactiveness, and self-reflectiveness aspects of human agency. Thus, this paper brings together terror management theory and human agency theory, highlighting the importance of maintaining an agentic self-concept during crisis situations such as the pandemic. It offers practical guidance to managers about navigating the times of such existential crises.

title: Factors Shaping the Usage of OTT Platforms in Bangladesh
affiliations: University of Dhaka, University of Dhaka, University of Dhaka and University of Dhaka

detail.title: Factors Shaping the Usage of OTT Platforms in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This paper examines the sociodemographic characteristics of the users of video streaming services in Bangladesh and the factors that motivated them to use those services, employing a quantitative research method. A cross-country survey (n = 734) was conducted to identify the sociodemographic features of the users, while a factor analysis was conducted to identify the factors that motivated viewers to watch over-the-top video on demand (OTTVoD) services. Bangladeshi users are predominantly young and male, and the majority of them are students. Local services are more popular than the global services. Bangladeshi viewers watch OTTVoD services to fulfill needs such as relaxation, information, convenience, entertainment, ease of use, social interaction, and financial benefit. This paper adds a new case study to the emerging field of video streaming research.

title: Global Inflation Spillovers and Regional Transmission Dynamics: Evidence from a TVP-VAR Connectedness Framework

detail.title: Global Inflation Spillovers and Regional Transmission Dynamics: Evidence from a TVP-VAR Connectedness Framework

keywords.keywords: Inflation spillover Global shocks Connectedness Approach based on TVP-VAR Internal Net Connectedness Index

detail.abstract: This study investigates the international spillover effects of inflation across 12 advanced and emerging economies, with a particular focus on the Asia-Oceania region. Employing a Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) model and Connectedness Approach, we quantify the dynamic transmission of inflationary shocks from 2000 to 2025. Our analysis incorporates crude oil prices as an exogenous upstream variable and distinguishes between RCEP member and non-member countries.The results reveal that inflation spillovers intensify during periods of global shocks, such as the 2008 financial crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, and geopolitical tensions, reaching Total Connectedness Index (TCI) levels as high as 90%. WTI crude oil has consistently emerged as the strongest net transmitter, followed by China and Thailand. Japan functions as a moderate transmitter, and its role is amplified during the post-earthquake and Abenomics periods. Since 2020, the United States has transitioned into a key transmitter driven by aggressive fiscal and monetary policies and a strong dollar.Within the RCEP bloc, intra-regional inflation connectedness is substantial, with China, Thailand, and Japan serving as the primary sources of price transmission. These findings underscore the need for monetary authorities to account for external inflationary pressure when designing domestic policy frameworks. This study contributes to the literature by offering a dynamic and regionally nuanced perspective on inflation spillovers and their implications for macroeconomic stability.
